sections.label: Hero
sections.writeInstructions: H1 ≈ title; high-ticket keywords left→right. Problem→promise→CTA. Service is the central entity; city secondary. Do not invent license ID numbers or founding years as hard facts.

sections.label: Trust / proof strip
sections.writeInstructions: Proof strip filled from site-config socialProof (rating, licenses, stats). Never invent awards, ratings, or testimonials beyond config. Prefer concrete trust lines operators can stand behind.

sections.label: Intro
sections.writeInstructions: Max ~2 concise salesperson paragraphs (not 180–220 words). Service-entity dense: materials/codes/equipment/stats. Allow ONE natural primaryCity mention; city remains secondary. When naming who does the work, use the full {businessName} (e.g. '{businessName} provides…'), not the niche alone. Weave one climate or housing cue from City context when available (paraphrase — never invent). Do NOT stuff streets/landmarks — put geo depth in areas. Do NOT pad the hero under-H1 (that stays the short tagline/description).

sections.label: What we do (services grid)
sections.writeInstructions: One short entity-rich paragraph per service card. High-ticket services first. What it is, when needed, outcome.

sections.label: Process / how we work
sections.writeInstructions: Numbered steps: consult → plan → install → follow-up. Realistic timing cues. Step titles should name the actual work (photo-searchable: site visit, demolition, install — not only Step 1). Prefer 'Permit filing' / 'Camera inspection' wording that implies the trade job, not parking signs or cinema cameras.

sections.label: Deep offer process (single-offer)
sections.defaultHeading: How {niche} works from start to finish
sections.writeInstructions: Deeper specialty process for single-offer niches. Methods, prep, install, cleanup. No multi-service grid.

sections.label: Why choose us
sections.writeInstructions: 3–5 concrete mid-page reasons rooted in real process/materials/communication (experience signals). Name the full {businessName}. Condensed — not a hero essay. No fake awards, years, or licenses beyond site-config socialProof.

sections.label: Locations
sections.writeInstructions: Primary home for geo entities (suburbs, local flavor from City context). Short local intent lines naming suburbs and, when listed in City context, neighborhoods or housing eras; link location pages if enabled. No fabricated demographics; no street stuffing.

sections.label: Cost & pricing guidance
sections.writeInstructions: Short natural intro (no city-stuffed lead) + 3–5 ballpark range bullets: **Tier** — $low–$high — what is typically included. Example: **Entry-level updates** — $2,500–$8,000 — fixtures and single-surface swaps. Honest local ranges only (not a fixed quote). Point to free estimate.

sections.label: Materials & methods
sections.writeInstructions: Short intro + 4–6 material option bullets. Each bullet: **Product/system name** — then 1–2 sentences (why it matters, climate or use cue from City context when available, durable outcome). Concrete photographable product names as titles (not “professional grade” alone). Do NOT include markdown body images — photos come from Rover Pull materialsImages (compact row thumbs).

sections.label: Timeline
sections.writeInstructions: Short natural human opener (e.g. how a typical project unfolds) — do NOT write "Typical stages for {city}...". Then stage bullets shaped `**Stage title** — duration` (e.g. Consult — same day; Permit approval — 1 week). Put timing ONLY in that duration cue — do NOT add "or next-day", "usually", or "varies by city/county" on the same bullet. Optional second clause only for real step description (what happens), not schedule hedging. Realistic timelines; no fabricated guarantees.

sections.label: Before & after
sections.writeInstructions: Optional short problem → solution captions (→). Photos come from Rover Website → ChatGPT before/after import (gallery-ba-*) — do not rely on stock Pull for this section. Never invent image paths.

sections.label: FAQs
sections.writeInstructions: 6–10 PAA-style Q&As about the niche/service only: when to call, cost drivers, timeline, DIY vs pro, maintenance, methods. Never city trivia, pets, civic officials, or unrelated appliances.

sections.label: Reviews
sections.writeInstructions: Only use reviews from site-config socialProof (not markdown body). Rover seeds exactly 3 Google-style cards (First L. names, 2 library avatars + 1 initials, staggered recent dates, business name / keyword / professional / affordable cues split across cards). Quote reviewer names/text from config; do not invent extra testimonials in markdown.

sections.label: Codes & permits
sections.writeInstructions: Two columns (### Usually needs a permit, then ### Usually no permit) with one bullet per item — expand comma lists into separate bullets. Short disclaimer to verify with city/county. Do not invent jurisdiction-specific legal claims.

sections.label: DIY vs hire a pro
sections.writeInstructions: Use ### DIY first, then ### Hire a pro (in that order), each with balanced bullet lists. Honest comparison: when DIY is fine vs when a pro saves money/risk. Do not use ## DIY / ## Hire a pro as separate H2s.

sections.label: When to call
sections.writeInstructions: Warning-sign / scenario bullets + CTA. Helpful, not alarmist.

sections.label: Closing CTA
sections.writeInstructions: Short close with phone/form CTA. Reinforce local service area.

sections.label: Service hero + card photo
sections.writeInstructions: H1 + ONE supporting sentence (~140–160 chars) reused as meta description: {serviceName} + {city} + 2–3 offer terms + free estimates. Never multi-paragraph under H1. Service-central; local intent; no invented credentials. Photos: one svcHero slot per name in site-config services and commercialServices (homepage What we do + More Services cards).

sections.label: Service intro
sections.writeInstructions: Max ~2 concise paragraphs defining this service. Service entity first; allow ONE natural {city} mention; city secondary. Unique materials/codes/stats. When the company acts, use full {businessName}. No street/landmark stuffing.

sections.label: What’s included / scope
sections.writeInstructions: Clear scope bullets under What’s included: **Typically included**, **Optional**, **Customer prep**. Honest boundaries. Never emit bare `Optional:` / `Customer prep:` lines outside this section (not after processImages or as free body prose).

sections.label: Service process

sections.label: Before & after

sections.label: Service FAQs

Each FAQ: question alone on its own line ending with `?`, then the answer on following lines. Never wrap questions or answers in markdown bold (`**`). Never put the answer before the question. Never city trivia, pets, civic officials, or unrelated appliances.

sections.label: About — our story

Lead with service experience: how estimates work, materials/climate knowledge from City context (paraphrase), what homeowners can expect. Use the full {businessName} as the company subject. Local commitment without street/landmark stuffing. Use only socialProof facts from site-config.

sections.label: Contact — how to reach us
sections.writeInstructions: Phone, email, service area, form CTA. Clear next step.

sections.label: Location intro
sections.writeInstructions: Local landing intro for this suburb (or primary-city page). Tie niche to community using City context climate/housing/neighborhood hints when present — paraphrase only; never invent local facts. Aim for substantive paragraphs — location pages should total ~600+ words across all loc* sections and must differ from other location files.

sections.label: Local notes
sections.writeInstructions: Local relevance unique to this city: housing stock or eras, climate/access cues for the niche, common jobs, nearby areas served. Use named neighborhoods from City context when listed. No fabricated demographics. Do not reuse the same paragraph across location files.

sections.label: Why local
sections.writeInstructions: 2–4 concrete reasons this team is a fit for this city (methods suited to local climate/housing, permits when relevant, written estimates). Use full businessName when the company acts. No invented awards or years. Keep reasons specific to {suburb} — not a clone of another city page.

sections.label: Location FAQs
sections.writeInstructions: 3–5 FAQ Q&As specific to this city and the niche (permits, timeline, methods, cost ranges, climate/housing constraints). Question lines end with ?; answers are one short paragraph each. Never city trivia, pets, civic officials, or unrelated appliances.

sections.label: Location CTA
sections.writeInstructions: Short CTA with phone/form; link back to Contact / Home.
